sequence.description: Publication sequence. Omit during intake to use the next number.

summary.description: The opening TL;DR and landing-card summary.

preview.description: A substantive expectation-setting preview of the full paper.

bodyHtml.description: Optional trusted field-note body rendered beneath the standard context heading. Completeness is assessed editorially, never by a word-count target.

requiresFullFieldNote.description: Set true for new published articles. The generator then requires a nonempty reader-facing bodyHtml and source-count parity; editorial review judges completeness without a word-count target.

expectedSourceCount.description: Expected count of visible reader-facing sources when requiresFullFieldNote is true.

publishedLabel.description: Landing-card date label. Omit during intake to use the current month.

lastModified.description: Omit during intake to use the current date.

showSocialPreview.description: When true, render the social preview above the white-paper download panel.

items.description: Inner HTML for one visible source-list item.
